cards.title: Reading order
items: Read downward: the delegate calls the entry, tools archive the letter, and ACP carries the reply back.

cards.title: Preserve failures; never invent success or resend blindly
items: Missing stop/cleanup evidence, refusal, and cancellation retain their actual status; see 06.
reply-ready confirms receipt integrity only. Content checks and adoption are in 04.
